item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan.

item.tests: Preserves an intentionally unusual business spelling and capitalization in the rendered logo.

answer_sheet.Exact name and capitalization: KwickFixx, with uppercase K and F and two lowercase x characters at the end.
answer_sheet.Visual style and colors: A simple repair-shop logo with a small orange wrench and black lettering on white.

must_haves: The rendered name reads exactly 'KwickFixx', preserving spelling and capitalization.
The name is legible and not obscured by the mark.
A small orange wrench accompanies black lettering.
The background is white and there is no slogan or additional text.

turns.text: i need a logo for my repair shop

dialog.agent:
Happy to make that. One quick question first:

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user where the content will be shown or posted and waits for an answer before going ahead.
dialog.user: idk, it's just for my repair shop. it should be square tho

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the logo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned the request down. I also tried the cheapest image model (about 5 credits per image) and got the same answer, so nothing was made and nothing was charged.

**To get it working:** add credits on your Magic Hour account (a credit pack or a plan upgrade), or wait for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run it again.

**What I tried to make:** a square logo with a wrench and screwdriver crossed inside a round badge with a gear outline. It's a clean, flat style on a white background, with no words.

While you sort out credits, a few things would make the logo better:
- **Shop name:** do you want the name in the logo? If so, tell me exactly how it's written. I left words out because I didn't want to guess.
- **Type of repair:** cars, phones, bikes, appliances, or something else? I can swap the tools to match.
- **Colours or style:** for example red and black, modern and simple, or old-school and vintage.
